decidedBy: Essenthos, 2026-10-13, on words that named the wrong record of a name two records share, or none: each read against its verse by claude-opus-5-5 on the project owner's instruction of 2026-10-13 ('PRB-1010-1014 - fix them'); no person has reviewed these rulings
policy: A word names the man, the people or the place its verse names. Where a record holds two men of one name, the man of the later verse is his own record; where a name is several records', the verse decides which; and a valley the sea later covered is not the sea.
source: Essenthos, names read again against their verses by claude-opus-5-5 on the project owner's instruction, 2026-10-13

create.name: Joah
create.distinguisher: a Gershonite Levite, son of Zimmah and father of Eden, who served under Hezekiah (2CH 29:12)
create.notes: David's Gershonite Joah son of Zimmah (1CH 6:20-21) stands many generations before Hezekiah's cleansing of the temple, so the Joah of this verse is another man of the same family.

rulings.why: 'Of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah' (2CH 29:12): the Gershonite who served when Hezekiah cleansed the temple. David's Gershonite Joah son of Zimmah (1CH 6:20-21, called Ethan in 6:42) stands generations earlier, and the Zimmah of this verse is already a man of his own.

'Of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah' (2CH 29:12): the Gershonite who served when Hezekiah cleansed the temple. David's Gershonite Joah son of Zimmah (1CH 6:20-21, called Ethan in 6:42) stands generations earlier, and the Zimmah of this verse is already a man of his own. The second Joah of the verse is the same man, Eden's father.

create.name: Shuppim
create.distinguisher: a Benjamite, brother of Huppim, of the children of Ir (1CH 7:12)
create.notes: Whether he is the Muppim of Genesis 46:21, the Shupham of Numbers 26:39 or the Shephuphan of 1 Chronicles 8:5 no verse says.

rulings.why: 'Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir' (1CH 7:12) and 'the sister of Huppim and Shuppim' (1CH 7:15) name Shuppim beside Huppim, not as Huppim and not as Muppim. The gatekeeper Shuppim of 1CH 26:16 is a Levite of David's day.

'And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum' (1CH 3:15): Kulish prints the firstborn as Йоахаз, as the Synodal prints him Иоахаз. The king Jehoahaz is the fourth, Shallum (JER 22:11), whom the same verse names Селлум.

create.name: Vale of Siddim
create.distinguisher: the valley where the kings of the plain fought, which the Salt Sea has since covered (GEN 14:3)
create.notes: 'All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea' (GEN 14:3): the valley lay where the Salt Sea later stood, and the vale was full of slimepits (GEN 14:10).

rulings.why: 'All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea' (GEN 14:3), and the battle of 14:8-10 is fought in the same vale, 'full of slimepits': a valley, which the verse says the Salt Sea now covers, and not the sea.

'When he strove with Aram-naharaim' (the title of Psalm 60): Aram of the two rivers, Mesopotamia. The mapping file writes the name as one word where BHSA writes two, so the word carries no number of its own to be named from.
'And with Aram-zobah' (the title of Psalm 60): the Aramean kingdom of Zobah, which David fought (2SA 8:3-5).
